body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8EZuqRp2sWT5mEbwB3fUdmh)_

Fixes #26573 (slice 4, the last: items `related-list-server-pagination`, `view-type-gallery` pinned; live-leg text on `adhoc-filter-sort-builder`, `conditional-rules-header`, `field-history-tracking`, `form-dirty-guard`, `record-discussion-mentions`, `v18-semantic-defaults`)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 2 个 dogfood 测试，钉住 related-list-server-pagination 与 view-type-gallery 的 api 条款的服务端一半；另有 6 项只在 `automated.ref` 里补一句为什么未钉条款留作现场腿（浏览器专属，或 record-discussion-mentions 等 #26625）。8 项 revision 各加 1，history 引本卡。
- 为什么改：按卡片 Done-when，21 项里每条列出的条款要么有 oracle 层的钉测，要么条目文字说明为何留作现场腿；本片补齐后 21 项全部满足，所以写 Fixes。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和清单文字，不动产品代码、不加 CI 车道；新文件在 dogfood 现有的 isolated 项目。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`related-list-server-paging-and-gate.dogfood.test.ts`（contributor 被 403、manager 200 的两端读权限）；`records-forms.json` 6 处只改说明文字的 `automated.ref`。
- 两分钟验证：先建依赖闭包，再 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/related-list-server-paging-and-gate.dogfood.test.ts test/view-type-gallery-data-halves.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件 5 个用例全绿；`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` 预期 OK。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

| Item (rev → new) | Change |
|---|---|
| `related-list-server-pagination` (8 → 9) | New `related-list-server-paging-and-gate.dogfood.test.ts`: the parent-scoped `GET /data/showcase_contact` holds Northwind's 26 contacts; `$top=10` pages at `$skip` 0/10/20 answer `total: 26` and 10/10/6 rows that partition the set (acceptance[1], negative[1] server half); each served child re-reads by id (acceptance[4]); a member staffed `contributor` is refused 403, one staffed `manager` reads 200 (acceptance[5], negative[2] server half). The console's request shape, pager text, relatedList config and tab absence are named as live browser legs. |
| `view-type-gallery` (2 → 3) | New `view-type-gallery-data-halves.dogfood.test.ts`: `GET /meta/view` serves the kanban view (status / estimate_hours), every one of the five columns holds seeded tasks, and the `POST /data/showcase_task/query` sum per status equals the raw rows grouped client-side (acceptance[1]); the calendar, timeline and gantt views name due_date, created_at and start_date → end_date with progress, and the seeded tasks carry them (acceptance[2]). acceptance[5] is named as the smoke spec's; the screenshot/dom clauses are named as live browser legs. |
| `adhoc-filter-sort-builder` (7 → 8) | `automated.ref` text only: acceptance[0]–[3], acceptance[4]'s same-request half and negative[0]–[3] stay live browser legs, and why. |
| `conditional-rules-header` (6 → 7) | `automated.ref` text only: acceptance[2]'s client lock, acceptance[4] and negative[2] are named as live browser legs. |
| `field-history-tracking` (8 → 9) | `automated.ref` text only: negative[1] and acceptance[2]'s absence half are named as live browser legs. |
| `form-dirty-guard` (4 → 5) | `automated.ref` text only: what the unit suite holds, and why acceptance[0]/negative[0]'s Escape and backdrop legs and acceptance[1] stay live browser legs (the re-read needs a browser to drive the guard's exit). |
| `record-discussion-mentions` (8 → 9) | `automated.ref` text only: acceptance[9]'s REST-door pin waits on #26625; until then its cross-organization leg stays a live leg on a walled boot. |
| `v18-semantic-defaults` (3 → 4) | `automated.ref` text only: the spec pins hold acceptance[0]; acceptance[1]–[3] stay live browser legs. |

One history row per item, citing #26573. No clause text, fixture, step or `knownGaps` line was edited (the claim's file surface).

## Why

The card's Done-when: every clause it lists either carries a pin at its oracle's layer, or the item text says why it stays a live leg; each touched item's `automated.ref` names the new pin with `revision` bumped and a `history` row citing the card; procedural clauses are left alone. Slices 1–3 (#26788, #26813, #26865) pinned fifteen items. This slice pins the last two that carry api clauses and writes the live-leg reason into the six items whose remaining clauses are browser-only or wait on #26625. A check of all 21 items against the card's clause lists finds every listed clause named in its item's `automated.ref`, as a pin or as a live leg with its reason. The triage ruling adds no CI lane, so the browser legs stay live legs rather than new Playwright specs.

## Tests

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- Dependency closure on `e78d7057` (the restarted branch) under `os-verify-lock.sh` (`Tasks: 67 successful, 67 total`), then the two files: the view file failed twice on its first run, because `GET /meta/view` wraps each view under `items[].config`; after that fix, and with the measured paging answer (`total: 26`, `hasMore`) pinned, `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)`. Then the dogfood typecheck: exit 0.
- Final head `8e3668c0` (after merging `origin/main` `c4a4aefc`, which brought a `packages/spec` change): the closure rebuilt (`Tasks: 67 successful, 67 total`), then the two files → `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)`, then `pnpm typecheck` in `packages/qa/dogfood`, one locked command, VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

No ablation was run: this diff adds tests and item text and changes no behaviour they pin. Each refusal assertion has a same-door admitted control beside it (the contributor's 403 against the manager's 200).

## Acceptance notes

- `view-type-gallery` acceptance[1] and [2] are pinned on their API half only: what the views declare and what the data door answers for the fields they name. Where a record lands on the canvas stays the browser leg the item's verify text describes.
- `related-list-server-pagination` acceptance[1] / negative[1]: the pin reads the server's paging (`total`, `hasMore`, disjoint pages); the console's pager text and its request's `top`/`skip` spelling stay browser legs.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0, `OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`, on the commit `f09120b3` and on the final head.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 55 commands on `f09120b3`, each run and reconciled with `--ran`: `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, all exit 0.
- Done-when check: for each of the card's 21 `Parked-on` lines, every listed clause is named in the item's `automated.ref`, either with its pin or as a live leg with its reason (a scripted cross-read of the card body against `records-forms.json`, then read by hand for the reasons).
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally. `Dogfood Regression Gate` does not run on pull_request, so the local runs above are this PR's evidence for the new pins.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI-owned run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — nothing publishes here (`@objectstack/dogfood` is private; `docs/qa/**` ships in no package), so `skip-changeset`; both declaration lines are filled in above.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief above is Chinese by the repo's communication rule).
